headlines.text: On this day in 2025, Bandido vs. Mascara Dorada put the ROH World Heavyweight Title on the line, appearing on Collision, rated 8.63 ? a match that lived up to every bit of hype. Bandido retained the ROH World Championship over Mascara Dorada in a rematch of their Arena Mexico classic, the two shaking hands and embracing afterward.

2023 brought us this moment: gold changed shoulders as the ROH World Six Man Tag Titles found a new champion as The Embassy vs. Young Bucks & Page battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.16 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. Swerve Strickland's distraction pulled Page away from the ring at the worst moment, letting Mogul Embassy steal the pin on Matt Jackson to reclaim the ROH Six-Man Tag Titles.
That Friday in 2024, JD Drake made their return to AEW television after 5 months away, appearing on Rampage.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2023, when Jericho & Omega was no more, reborn as The Golden Jets after 3 matches, on Dynamite.
Flash back to 2025, when Olympia kicked off their AEW journey against Mercedes Mone, appearing on Collision, rated 6.36.
That Wednesday in 2023, Hikaru Shida vs. Willow Nightingale put the AEW Women's World Title on the line, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.74.
